question: What is the primary function of the Crew Escape System (CES) on ISRO's Human Rated LVM3 (HLVM3) rocket?

options.text: To guide the crew module into its designated Low Earth Orbit.
To eject the crew module to safety during launch emergencies.
To assist in docking the crew module with a space station.
To provide thermal shielding during re-entry into Earth's atmosphere.

solution:
The Correct answer is __**To eject the crew module to safety during launch emergencies**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Crew Escape System (CES)** is a critical safety feature integrated into the **ISRO's Human Rated LVM3 (HLVM3) rocket**.
 
• Its primary function is to **eject the crew module safely** in case of any **emergency during the launch or ascent phase**.
 
• The CES ensures the **safety of astronauts** in scenarios such as rocket malfunctions,
